fieldValues.title: RFC-026 [R5]/[R6]/[R13] still read against retired containerIndex/instanceIndex -- Door 3, not folded
fieldValues.summary: RFC-038's own stub record claims to amend RFC-026 [R5]/[R6]/[R13], but rfcs/rfc-026-ext-slices-subset-export.md's own rule text for all three still reads verbatim against containerIndex/instanceIndex, with no amendment annotation and no invariant record restating them against the tree-authoritative store (unlike RFC-013 [R6]->I-82, RFC-013 [R9] self-annotated inline, and RFC-017 [R2]/[R12]->I-102/I-112, which are folded). Filed as srs#766.
fieldValues.rationale: Fixing this means bumping RFC-026's own Revision and editing its rule text, or adding an inline amendment annotation the way RFC-013 [R9] got -- that is Door 3 (amending an Accepted RFC's own normative surface), which a Door-1 unit declaring RFC-038's manifest must not do inline. Do not fold RFC-026's amendment as a side effect of a future RFC-038-adjacent unit; it needs its own RFC-revision PR citing srs#766. check-rfc-integration.mjs does not currently catch this -- RFC-026's own manifest (ext:slices, schema:manifest.json) is already non-empty and every token it declares resolves, so the gate stays green until srs#766 is worked.
